_comment: Endpoints that live in the Postman collection but are NOT generated from src/routes/.
`npm run update-postman -- --prune` deletes stale collection entries EXCEPT these.
Seeded 2026-07-29 when the route scanner was fixed. Before that it built fullPath as
a hardcoded '/api' + the route's in-file path, so 143 entries pointed at URLs that
404 (e.g. /api/:policyId for a route that really serves at /api/policies/:policyId).
Those 143 were provably scanner artifacts and were pruned. The entries below were
never produced by any scanner run, so they are genuine manual additions - proxied
endpoints, or routes that live outside src/routes/ - and are kept.
Add a line here if you hand-add an endpoint to the collection that has no route file.
